title: EvaluationOutput
description: Structured output emitted by a single specialized evaluator agent for one candidate on one dimension. LLMs emit this; they do NOT emit final overall scores — the deterministic aggregator combines per-dimension scores using the weighting policy. Every output must validate against this schema before use; reject/retry on malformed output. See design §50, §31, §32.

confidence.description: Evaluator's confidence in this assessment, 0.0–1.0. Low confidence may route to human review. See design §51, §52.

evidence.description: Supporting evidence drawn from the transcript. Required for explainability — no unexplained scores. See design §57 Principle 12, NFR-08.

timestamp.description: Transcript timestamp the evidence refers to, e.g. '05:14'.

summary.description: Short description of what happened at that point.

evidence.summary: A acknowledged B's concern and extended it.
